overview_description.description: Platable is a digital platform focused on restaurant operations and food service management. It provides tools that support online ordering, menu handling, and customer engagement for hospitality businesses. The platform is designed to help restaurants manage day-to-day processes through web-based services and integrations. It operates within the restaurant technology and food service software sector.
